Rules: Emperor Edition core rules; curated Effect/Ability IDs, never inferred from prose.

Cards.Name: Ring of Air
Cards.Text:
Play after you resolve two or more Favor actions in one turn. You may discard this Ring from your hand to use its ability without cost.
Air Repeatable Battle/Open, Bow this card: Straighten your target Personality or attachment.

Cards.Name: Ring of Water
Cards.Text:
Play after a battle resolves in which you played a Terrain, destroyed a Terrain, and destroyed any cards or provinces during resolution. You may discard this Ring from your hand to use its ability without cost.
Water Absent Repeatable Battle, Bow this card: Move your target Personality home or, if he would be opposed, move your target Personality at any location to the current battlefield.

Cards.Name: Ring of the Void
Cards.Text:
You may discard this Ring from your hand to use its Void ability without cost.
Limited: Play if you have two or fewer Rings in play. Discard your hand. 
Void Limited, Bow this card: Draw a card. If you now have more cards in your hand than any other player, discard a card.

Cards.Name: False Ring of Air
Cards.Text:
Does not count towards an Enlightenment Victory.
After you win a battle in which there was ever a unit on the opposing side, you may put this Ring into play and lose 2 Honor.
Absent Battle, Bow this card: Give a target Personality -3F. (Absent actions can be taken without presence.)

Cards.Name: False Ring of Water
Cards.Text:
Does not count towards an enlightenment victory.
Battle: If the current battlefield's Province Strength is 11 or greater, put this Ring into play and lose 2 Honor.
Battle, Bow this card: Ranged 3 Attack.

Cards.Name: Ring of Earth
Cards.Text:
After the resolution of a battle that you won, if there were ever any enemy units at that battlefield and none of your Personalities were destroyed during the battle: You may put this card into play from your hand.
Battle: Even if you control no units at the current battlefield, bow this card or discard it from your hand: Give a province +3 or -3 strength.

Cards.Name: Ring of Fire
Cards.Text:
After the resolution of a battle at a province, if you destroyed one or more provinces or enemy cards in that resolution: You may put this card into play from your hand.
Battle: Bow this card or discard it from your hand, destroy your performing Personality, and target an enemy Personality with equal or lower Chi: Destroy him.
